title: Figure 9: Elements of the 2 kW FEL at Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility
description: Color layout diagram of a free-electron laser facility showing an injector, Linac, RF Power and Controls, Helium Refrigerator, IR Wiggler, Optical System and a looping Beam Transport line, with a 10 m scale bar.
